1.consolidated_definition: art. espec. Representar, actuar. Realizar representaciones variadas de canto, baile, o actuación. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. Un factor final nos ayudará a ubicar a Teresa Hernández y su contribución artística dentro del teatro puertorriqueño. No importa si ha sido escribir, dirigir o performar, las mayores contribuciones artísticas al teatro puertorriqueño muestran una innegable creatividad femenina
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To represent or act in a special capacity; to perform varied representations of singing, dancing, or acting. An Anglicism adapted from English, relatively infrequent.

A final factor will help us locate Teresa Hernández and her artistic contribution within Puerto Rican theater. It does not matter if she has been writing, directing, or performing; the greatest artistic contributions to Puerto Rican theater demonstrate an undeniable feminine creativity
